<thought>We need to create a dataset of oxide polymorphs, then train and evaluate an XGBoost model. I will first define a list of 40 common oxide compositions, retrieve their polymorph data with the specified energy and count limits, consolidate the JSON files into one dataset, prepare a tabular CSV dataset with advanced feature engineering, train the XGBoost model using the given hyperparameters, evaluate it on the test set, perform 5‑fold cross‑validation, and finally write the required metrics to a JSON file. The path to that JSON file will be returned as the answer.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
